timeOfDay.Golden Hour: bathed in warm, cinematic golden hour light, casting long dramatic shadows to emphasize the {{tone}} atmosphere
timeOfDay.Midnight: illuminated solely by stark moonlight and ambient emissive glows against a pitch-black, star-studded sky
timeOfDay.Overcast: under a flat, moody overcast sky providing soft, diffused lighting and muted colors
timeOfDay.Stormy: lit by sudden, dramatic flashes of lightning amidst churning, dark storm clouds
timeOfDay.Neon Night: illuminated by harsh, artificial neon lights casting deep, colorful reflections

tone.Epic: conveying a sense of grand, monumental scale and overwhelming awe
tone.Grim: steeped in a dark, oppressive, and melancholic atmosphere
tone.Cozy: evoking a profound sense of warmth, safety, and tranquil comfort
tone.Mysterious: shrouded in enigma and fog, suggesting hidden depths and untold secrets
tone.Action-Packed: capturing a frozen moment of high-kinetic energy and explosive motion

imageStyle.Cinematic 3D: rendered in Unreal Engine 5 style, photorealistic, 35mm lens, volumetric fog, ray-traced lighting
imageStyle.Stylized 2D: vibrant vector-style illustration, cel-shaded, clean lines, inspired by Studio Ghibli
imageStyle.Dark Fantasy Art: painterly digital art style, heavy brushstrokes, chiaroscuro lighting, reminiscent of Frank Frazetta
imageStyle.Anime Style: high-quality anime key visual style, dynamic perspective, vibrant FX animation frames
imageStyle.Broadcast Realism: ultra-realistic, 8k resolution, sports photography style with deep depth of field

fontStyle.Bold Serif: designed to complement bold, elegant serif typography
fontStyle.Cyber Glitch: designed to complement aggressive, neon-glitching cyberpunk typography
fontStyle.Soft Rounded: designed to complement gentle, rounded, and playful typography
fontStyle.Blocky Impact: designed to complement massive, high-impact block lettering
fontStyle.Elegant Script: designed to complement flowing, historical calligraphy or script fonts

textPlacements.Top Left: ensure a clear, uncluttered negative space in the top-left quadrant
textPlacements.Center Bottom: maintain a dark, low-detail area across the bottom center
textPlacements.Right Third: keep the right-hand third of the composition relatively empty and low-contrast
textPlacements.Top Center: leave the top-middle area free of complex details for centered text

goal.High CTR: optimized for thumbnail readability, utilizing extreme contrast, vibrant focal points, and clear silhouettes
goal.Lore Focus: packed with subtle environmental storytelling, authentic runic details, and canon-accurate artifacts
goal.Vibe / Relaxing: prioritizing a soothing color palette and harmonious composition to induce relaxation
goal.Hype / Reaction: designed to induce excitement with extreme facial expressions or explosive background action

elements.fire: roaring, chaotic magical fire illuminating the surroundings
elements.camp: a rustic, weathered adventuring campsite providing brief sanctuary
elements.forest: a dense, overgrown ancient forest shrouded in thick canopy shadows
elements.mountains: towering, jagged mountain peaks reaching into a turbulent sky
elements.stars: a brilliant, sprawling celestial starlight canopy piercing the darkness
elements.magic aura: a crackling, ethereal magic aura radiating immense raw power
elements.rain: heavy, cinematic pouring rain reflecting ambient environmental lights
elements.fog: a thick, clinging, and mysterious ground fog obscuring fine details
elements.snow: a relentless, driving blizzard covering the desolate landscape in white
elements.blood: visceral, dramatic blood splatters telling a story of intense conflict
